name: Not Your Day
source:
"You wake up in an incomprehensible basement, your head hurts and it turns out that you have been kidnapped. 

Who are your kidnappers? 

What do they want? 

And most importantly - can you get out alive?"

[From [url=https://daniel-velitskiy.itch.io/not-your-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你在一个莫名其妙的地下室里醒来，头痛欲裂，才发现自己被绑架了。

绑架你的是谁？

他们想要什么？

最重要的是——你能活着逃出去吗？”

[摘自[url=https://daniel-velitskiy.itch.io/not-your-day]Itch.io[/url]]
